memos.scout:
Honest case for buying now: thin. The strongest points are real volume and breadth: 2,772 buyers and $1.8M volume over the last 15 minutes, a 1.56 return in that window, and a 30-minute return of about 10x. Post-graduation buying was broad (234 buyers, top-5 buyer share only 13%), and the coin is alive with a deep-enough pool (349.7 SOL) for a $20 round trip.

But the brief undercuts the bullish read. The curve shows bundle_share of 1.0 and completer_share of 0.69, meaning bundled buying dominated the curve, and the top-3 holders hold 74% of supply. The first two minutes show a launch bot and a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.96, with 7,502 SOL sold in the last 15 minutes against 7,775 bought: heavy two-way churn, not accumulation. The coin is already 11% off its 30-minute high, and most of its gain is recent. Demand that is 2,138 sellers strong in the same window is not evidence it will persist 30-60 minutes out.

Verdict: no strong case to buy. Skip.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: a late exit into insider distribution. The curve shows bundle_share 1.0 and completer_share 0.69, meaning the bundled wallets that opened the position were also the ones finishing the bonding curve, so the supply concentration is baked in. top3_share of 0.74 and top5_buyer_share of 0.13 on the 2-minute post-graduation window say a few wallets hold most of the float. The last 15 minutes show 7,774 SOL bought against 7,502 SOL sold, with net flow of only 272 SOL, so the 1.56x return is being absorbed by sellers rather than new demand. A 10x run-up followed by an 11% drawdown and a launch bot present points to insiders taking profit into retail. A $20 ticket with 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs needs a sustained move to clear fees; a 10% chop likely returns a loss.
